relations.subject: William Frederick Sinclair
relations.evidence: British Civil Servant in India. Son of William Sinclair, D.L. Joined I.C.S. in 1866

relations.subject: William Frederick Sinclair
relations.evidence: arrived at Bombay 1868. Served in various administrative positions in Bombay Presidency

relations.subject: William Frederick Sinclair
relations.evidence: finally 1890-94 Senior Collector in Thana, then retired.
